concept.title: Secure Wireless Networks
concept.shortdesc: Learn the difference between secure and unsecured wireless networks.

conbody.p: Secure networks encode the information sent between your device and the network so others can't read it. Unsecured networks do not do this.

section.title: NC State's Wireless Networks
section.p: eduroam is the preferred network for staff because it has a secured, encrypted connection.
ncsu (Nomad) is unsecured and unencrypted and is meant for devices like smart TVs and game consoles.

p.xref: To compare all networks, see NC State wireless networks.

section.title: Working Off Campus
section.p: eduroam also works at participating institutions, like other universities during conferences, without needing guest access.
Staff must use the NC State VPN with two-factor authentication to reach certain campus resources while off campus, such as WolfPrint and campus file services.

section.title: Working Off Campus
section.p: While working from a seperate location always ensure that the Wifi is secure. If you must access sensitive work applications remotely, use a VPN. Additionally, always use encrypted devices since small devices are highly succeptable to loss or theft.
